rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved, conducted or sponsored by an accredited institution of higher learning, a county/state/federal agency, a professional association, or a mental health agency providing clinical mental health or SUD treatment services (certificate required). Other credit per DOPL guide: university teaching (no limit), conference presentations (max 5), clinical readings (max 10), volunteer service (max 10), supervision/direct observation by approved supervisors (max 10 each), peer consultation (max 10), professional board service (max 6).
rules.new_licensee_rule: First cycle, licensed under 2 full years: 1.6 hours per month licensed (issue date to expiration).
rules.audit_note: CE documentation is submitted only if audited by the Division; certificates must show name, provider, instructor, date, title, objectives and hours.
rules.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R156-60e (Mental Health Professional Practice Act Rule), incl. R156-60e-402.1; Utah Code Title 58 Chapter 60
rules.notes: Renewal due September 30 of even years. 15 of the 40 hours must relate directly to marriage and family therapy. At least 30 hours in-person or live interactive webinars; max 10 hours online self-study.
